description: This Dart source file defines the `AppDatabase` class with methods for managing a SQLite database for download management and watch history tracking in a streaming app. It includes table creation, inserting and querying watch progress, and handling a download queue state.

classes.name: AppDatabase
classes.description: Manages the SQLite database lifecycle and provides methods to interact with download and watch history data.

classes.name: WatchHistoryEntry
classes.description: Represents a watch history record with content ID, position in seconds, and last updated timestamp.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Initializes and opens the database connection, creating tables if necessary.

methods.name: upsertWatchProgress
methods.description: Inserts or replaces a watch progress entry for a specific content ID.

methods.name: getWatchProgressSeconds
methods.description: Retrieves the last watch position in seconds for a given content ID.

methods.name: getRecentWatchHistory
methods.description: Returns a list of recent watch history entries ordered by most recent update.

methods.name: getDownloadQueuePaused
methods.description: Checks if the download queue is paused.

methods.name: setDownloadQueuePaused
methods.description: Updates the paused state of the download queue.
